input: Research home birth midwifery options in my area

gold.taskTitle: Research local home birth midwifery options
gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate home birth midwifery providers available in the user's area.

questions.title: What city, region, or zip code should we search in?
questions.description: Identify the geographic area to focus the midwifery search on.

questions.title: What is your current stage or estimated due date?
questions.description: Understand the urgency and timeline for finding a midwife.

questions.title: Do you prefer a Certified Nurse-Midwife or Certified Professional Midwife?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred credential type, as they differ in training and legal standing.

questions.title: Is this your first home birth or a repeat experience?
questions.description: Understand prior experience to tailor the depth and focus of research.

questions.title: What is your approximate budget or insurance situation?
questions.description: Determine financial constraints to filter realistic options.

questions.title: Are there specific services you need beyond delivery itself?
questions.description: Identify needs such as prenatal care, postpartum visits, or water birth support.

questions.title: How important are reviews, referrals, or personal recommendations?
questions.description: Understand whether trust signals like word-of-mouth or online ratings are a priority.
